title: Ringo's Terraria Core
description: A core mod that adds some content from Terraria
body:
A core mod that adds some content from Terraria. 

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a93231d8365246ebdd6a12af9f741e774098c08.png)

It adds two biomes—Crimson and Distortion—as well as plants and other sub-items.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11fb98ab536e6282d504e5905161aa7d3c38036e_0.webp)

This mod has almost all the effects from Terraria. A new mod will be published soon, which allows you to create potions.
